hero.lead: Web developer and designer. I build custom websites and apps for businesses and professionals in Catalonia.

services.title: Services
services.intro: Open what interests you and tick it: I'll add it to your order.
services.summary_zero: You haven't ticked any services yet.

items.title: Custom management apps
items.description: Tools built around the way you work: clients, bookings, inventory or whatever you need, all in one place. No more spreadsheets that don't talk to each other.

items.title: Gym management
items.description: Members, fees, schedules and class bookings from a single app. You focus on training and spend less time on paperwork.

items.title: Custom portfolio websites
items.description: A site that shows your work the way it deserves, designed from scratch with no templates. Ideal for creatives and professionals who want to stand out.

items.title: Simple WordPress websites
items.description: A simple, fast website you can update yourself. Perfect for getting online without the hassle.

items.title: SEO management
items.description: I help people find you on Google: technical review, content and your Google Business profile. More visits from people looking for exactly what you offer.

items.title: Apps for small businesses
items.description: I digitise your business processes with apps built for small teams: quotes, orders or tasks. Easy to use from day one.

items.title: Graphic Designer Website
items.description: A portfolio for a graphic designer, with the work and services in a fast website. The work comes first and the contact details are always within reach.

items.title: Training platform
items.description: A web app for coaches: it keeps training plans and athlete follow-up in one place, on a phone or a computer.

items.title: Athletics parents' portal
items.description: A portal where athletes' families follow results and sports news without digging through group chats.

paragraphs: I help people and businesses get a website that is clear, tidy and easy to use.
I focus on fixing confusing or careless websites, combining design, development and close attention to detail.
I've been building websites for over 3 years and have delivered more than 20 projects, mostly with React, Firebase and WordPress.
You work directly with me: we talk, I show you proposals and we refine them until the site does the job you need.
